# Mistfall Hunter Classes

> Mistfall Hunter Classes is a fan-made guide and build planner for comparing roles, risk, and build direction before a run.

## Core Content
- [Main planner](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/): Interactive Mistfall Hunter class planner and role overview.
- [Classes guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/classes/): Class role profiles, risk notes, and beginner direction.
- [Build planner](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/build-planner/): Dedicated planner page for build-intent searches.
- [Price guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/price/): Steam price snapshot, launch discount, buyer checks, and refund-source guidance.
- [Player count guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/player-count/): SteamDB chart interpretation, current-player signals, and queue-timing guidance.
- [Map guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/map-guide/): Map markers, key-route decisions, community map references, and extraction planning.
- [Tier list guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/tier-list/): Mode-specific class tier list with solo, duo, squad, and beginner decisions.
- [PS5 guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/ps5/): Official Mistfall Hunter PS5 availability, release, price, and platform comparison checks.
- [Steam info](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/steam/): Official Steam facts and safe source links.
- [Review guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/review/): Independent Mistfall Hunter review covering the game loop, class fit, buyer checks, and tradeoffs.
- [Gameplay guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/gameplay/): Mistfall Hunter gameplay guide covering the extraction loop, combat decisions, class rhythm, and beginner mistakes.

## Common Resources
- [About](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/about/): Editorial policy and source handling.
- [Contact](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/contact/): Correction and feedback contact route.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/privacy-policy/): Privacy and planner data handling.

- [PS5 guide](https://mistfallhunterclasses.blog/ps5/): Added on 2026-08-19 with official PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam checks, three visual points, localized FAQ content, and platform comparison guidance.
